speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nobody came in the night. Say the sentence anyway, while the bread is being cut. I have the knife in my hand, so be short.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: From Norwich. I slept. The house was quiet, and I was quiet in it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I did not open. There was nothing at the door to open to.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is shrunk on the pan. A penny. Eat, and keep the house. You are not cast, Master Shakespeare, and the street is not your errand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not cast. I am in this room. The sheets stay on the board.
